title: Intermediate Vinyasa Flow
description: A dynamic Vinyasa flow class for practitioners with established yoga experience. This class features creative sequencing, challenging transitions, and opportunities to explore more advanced pose variations. Build strength, endurance, and flexibility while deepening your breath-movement connection.
requirements: Familiarity with Sun Salutations and basic poses
Ability to flow through sequences with guided instruction
Please inform the instructor of any injuries or health concerns
cancellationPolicy: Cancel up to 2 hours before class
